# One row from Cartwheel's messy export, exactly as it arrived
price_text = " $129.00"
quantity_text = "2"
discount = 0.15

# 1. Turn price_text into a float
price = None

# 2. Turn quantity_text into an int
quantity = None

# 3. Line revenue = quantity * price * (1 - discount), rounded to 2 decimals
line_revenue = None

# 4. True when line_revenue is 200 or more

solution:
price_text = " $129.00"
quantity_text = "2"
discount = 0.15

price = float(price_text.strip().replace("$", ""))
quantity = int(quantity_text)
line_revenue = round(quantity * price * (1 - discount), 2)
is_large = line_revenue >= 200
